title: Toddler in Striped Overalls, Lawn Sidewalk - Vintage 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length snapshot capturing a young toddler standing on a grassy front lawn. The child is dressed in vertically striped overalls or rompers paired with a short-sleeved undershirt, holding a small object or treat up to their mouth. In the background, a curved sidewalk borders the yard alongside a quiet, tree-lined suburban street with classic period houses, evoking domestic childhood in 1920s America.
